title: Photonic Interconnect for Accelerated Computing Celestial AI Photonic Fabric Module - The world's first SoC with in-die Optical IO
problem: AI accelerator systems require on-die optical I/O to overcome electrical interconnect bandwidth and power density limitations, enabling scalable many-accelerator configurations.
motivation: AI scale-up demands exceed electrical I/O capabilities; integrated optical I/O enables efficient cluster communication with higher bandwidth density and lower energy per bit.
method: Celestial AI implements monolithic optical I/O on a single SoC die combining photonic modulators, detectors, and waveguides with electrical compute logic to enable direct optical communication.
key_novelty: World's first SoC with integrated in-die optical I/O for direct photonic interconnect without external optics.
contributions: First integrated optical I/O on a monolithic SoC die
In-die photonic fabric for direct optical communication
Scalable optical interconnect for AI cluster communication
Reduced power per bit vs. electrical I/O
primary_theme: monolithic optical I/O SoC for AI acceleration
